name: US Physical Therapists & PT Clinics — NPI Database 2026 — 377,805 Records (CSV)
summary: Every active licensed Physical Therapist and PT clinic in the US — 377,805 records from the CMS NPPES National Provider Identifier registry, April 2026. Includes practice location phone number on 99.98% of records. One-time purchase. CarePrecise charges $859+ for access to the same CMS data infrastructure.
audience: Medical SaaS vendors selling EMR, scheduling, billing, and outcomes tracking tools to PT practices; medical equipment and supply reps (ultrasound, electrotherapy, exercise equipment); healthcare staffing agencies recruiting PTs and PTAs; liability insurance brokers; PT-focused CE providers; and outpatient rehab chains doing competitive market mapping.
source: CMS NPPES National Provider Identifier Registry — April 2026 V2 monthly bulk download (download.cms.gov/nppes/NPI_Files.html) — U.S. federal open data, mandatory public disclosure under HIPAA 45 CFR § 162.410
